entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I got a message from Akechi-kun.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He wants us to gather at[n]Leblanc tomorrow after school.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Who does he think he is, trying[n]to boss us around like that!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is directly after the reward[n]announcement. There must be a[n]calculated reason for this too.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Yeah. We're going to[n]overcome this, together.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sure there's a way.[n]We decided to overcome[n]this together, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Regardless, I don't want anyone[n]disturbing our pace anymore.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's go about this calmly.[n]Well, see you all tomorrow.
